label: Theme
tooltip: Open the Blender-owned Theme page for UI colors, Place Picture, grid, and HDRI controls.

page.label: Theme
page.tooltip: Set Blender UI colors, Place Picture and grid settings, and the HDRI environment.

copy.samplingPalette: Choosing and sampling the reference image…

actionTooltips.theme.image.select: Pick an image, sample theme colors, and place it as the Place Picture image.
actionTooltips.theme.image.sample: Sample theme colors from the selected reference image.
actionTooltips.theme.absorb: Read the current Blender theme and stage all visible buckets.
actionTooltips.theme.refill: Randomly remix the staged sampled colors into a different bucket set and apply it.
actionTooltips.theme.fields.save: Save the current staged Blender theme buckets for later reuse.
actionTooltips.theme.fields.load: Load saved Blender theme buckets back into this page.
actionTooltips.theme.package.save: Save the actual theme image(s) plus the staged bucket colors into the Blender themes folder.
actionTooltips.theme.package.open: Pick a saved theme package, or browse for one.
actionTooltips.theme.package.previous: Load the previous saved theme package.
actionTooltips.theme.package.next: Load the next saved theme package.
actionTooltips.theme.mode.dark: Stage a dark theme preset on this page. Apply sends it to Blender.
actionTooltips.theme.mode.light: Stage a light theme preset on this page. Apply sends it to Blender.
actionTooltips.theme.profile.save: Save the current darkness settings under the entered profile name.
actionTooltips.theme.apply: Apply the currently visible theme role colors.
actionTooltips.picture.apply: Place the picture path in the Blender viewport with the overlay.
actionTooltips.picture.grid: Apply the entered near, distance, and far grid spacing values.
actionTooltips.picture.grid.remove: Hide only the fake grid; keep any Place Picture image and gizmos active.
actionTooltips.picture.startup: Save the current Place Picture image so Blender restores it on startup.
actionTooltips.picture.clear: Remove the Place Picture background, grid, and gizmos, and clear the picture path.
actionTooltips.environment.apply: Apply the HDRI path in the field.
actionTooltips.environment.clear: Clear the current HDRI world from this file.
actionTooltips.environment.reset: Rebuild a clean Blender world for this file and reapply the current HDRI values.

fields.label: Theme reference image
fields.placeholder: Choose a photo or palette image
